news.title: Black Hills Corp. and NorthWestern Energy Complete Merger, Forming Bright Horizon Energy Corporation
Chime Financial Set to Join S&P MidCap 400
Subject to Receipt of Satisfactory Final Regulatory Approval and Completion of Proposed Merger, Black Hills Corp. to be Renamed Bright Horizon Energy Corporation with Ticker Symbol “HZN”
